item.title: Entrepreneurial ethics: moral cognition, affect, and action under uncertainty
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores the ethical dimensions of entrepreneurship, focusing on how entrepreneurs engage in moral reasoning and decision-making. The call seeks research that examines the cognitive and emotional processes underlying ethical choices that entrepreneurs face, particularly in contexts marked by uncertainty and risk. The issue aims to advance understanding of how moral considerations shape entrepreneurial behavior and venture development.

Researchers are invited to submit work investigating the intersection of ethics, cognition, and emotion in entrepreneurial contexts. The special issue welcomes diverse perspectives on how entrepreneurs navigate ethical dilemmas, the role of affect in moral judgments, and mechanisms through which ethical considerations translate into concrete actions during the venture creation process.

Appel publié par Journal of Business Venturing. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Moral cognition in entrepreneurship
  • Affective processes in ethical decision-making
  • Ethical action under uncertainty
  • Entrepreneurial decision-making and ethics
  • Moral reasoning in venture creation
  • Emotional dimensions of ethical behavior

Timeline

  • September 1, 2027: Submission deadline

item.title: Revisiting theoretical pillars of HRM in the age of uncertainty: Contributions for performance
item.content:encoded:
Organizations face unprecedented challenges from uncertainty, technological change, and shifting work arrangements. This special issue calls for researchers to revisit fundamental HRM theories and examine whether established assumptions adequately explain the relationship between people, organizations, and performance in today's turbulent context. The issue seeks to move beyond incremental complexity by returning to core concepts and critically assessing whether traditional perspectives on HRM-strategy alignment, employee development, and performance outcomes remain sufficient.

The special issue welcomes theoretically grounded and methodologically rigorous contributions that challenge conventional HRM wisdom and propose new understandings relevant to uncertain environments. Research may address tensions and unintended consequences of HRM practices, sustainability concerns, digitalization, employee well-being, and emerging employment models. Empirical studies, conceptual papers, and literature reviews are all welcome, provided they offer clear advances to HRM theory and research.

Appel publié par Journal of Organizational Effectiveness: People and Performance. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

item.title: AI-Driven Decision Making under Uncertain Environments: Theory, Methods, and Industrial Applications
item.content:encoded:
Hyun-Jung Kim, KAIST

Shu-Kai Fan, National Taipei University of Technology

Fugee Tsung, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

Thomas Volling, Technical University Berlin

Jang Ho Kim, Korea University

Dong-Young Lim, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology

This special issue addresses decision-making in complex industrial systems facing dynamic uncertainty through artificial intelligence and optimization techniques. The issue seeks research combining AI methods such as reinforcement learning, generative AI, and digital twins with operations research and optimization approaches to manage manufacturing, supply chains, healthcare, and other sectors dealing with demand fluctuations and disruptions.

The special issue welcomes both theoretical and practical contributions demonstrating how AI-driven methodologies can improve decision-making under uncertainty. Particular emphasis is placed on interdisciplinary research with clear industrial applicability and the adoption of open science practices including data and code sharing to enhance reproducibility.

Appel publié par International Journal of Production Research. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • AI-driven decision-making under uncertainty
  • Production planning and scheduling in stochastic and dynamic environments
  • Reinforcement learning for uncertain industrial systems
  • Stochastic optimization and robust operational strategies
  • AI-enabled statistical quality control and process improvement
  • Hybrid AI and optimization approaches for uncertain environments
  • Data-driven optimization and prescriptive analytics
  • AI-enhanced supply chain and logistics management under disruptions
  • Real-time and adaptive decision-making systems
  • Simulation-based optimization and digital twins under uncertainty
  • Agentic AI and autonomous industrial systems
  • Explainable and trustworthy AI for operational decision-making
  • AI for resilient and sustainable operations
  • Industrial applications and case studies of AI-driven decision systems
